questions.stem: What is the volume of a sphere with radius $3\text{ cm}$? Give your answer in terms of $\pi$.
questions.explanation: Volume of a sphere $= \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3 = \frac{4}{3} \times \pi \times 27 = 36\pi\text{ cm}^3$.

questions.stem: Which formula gives the volume of a sphere?
questions.explanation: The volume of a sphere is $\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3$. Note that $4\pi r^2$ is the surface area formula.
